note: A 1 N m torque about the x axis acts on a sphere (mass 1, radius 0.3, inertia 0.036 kg m2): it gains about 27.8 rad/s every second in the bridge (the test allows 22 to 33 because the wait is wall-clock and the clock of a software-rendered page jitters). X_ITE 16.6.0 keeps the fields and applies no torque.
gaps: the bridge applies axisNTorque about motorNAxis (fixed in body 1) on body 2 and the opposite on body 1 for the first enabledAxes axes; autoCalc and the stop bounce and error correction fields are kept and not used
motorNAngle is the signed twist of body 2 about each axis; X_ITE 16.6.0 has no motor at all
